worked_solution:
The formula for the derivative of $arcsec$ is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(arcsecx)=\frac{1}{|x|\sqrt{{x}^{2}-1}}.
$$

Using the chain rule and the formula above, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(2arcsec(6x-1)) \\  & =2\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(arcsec(6x-1)) \\  & =2\cdot \frac{1}{|6x-1|\sqrt{(6x-1)^{2}-1}}\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(6x-1) \\  & =2\cdot \frac{1}{|6x-1|\sqrt{{(6x-1)}^{2}-1}}\cdot 6 \\  & =\frac{12}{|6x-1|\sqrt{36{x}^{2}-12x}} \\  & =\frac{12}{|6x-1|\sqrt{4(9{x}^{2}-3x)}} \\  & =\frac{6}{|6x-1|\sqrt{9{x}^{2}-3x}}.\end{aligned}
$$
